info.title: wuFlow API
info.description: API documentation for the wuFlow application.

project_id.description: ID of the project this label belongs to

position.description: Non-negative integer for ordering within the issue

owner_id.description: ID of the user responsible for this release

owner.description: Embedded owner user object, present when owner_id is set

label.description: Assigned label object; null if no label

release.description: Assigned release object; null if no release

stage1_name.description: Display name for Stage1 column. Default: 'Pending'. Empty = hidden.

stage2_name.description: Display name for Stage2 column. Default: 'Working'. Empty = hidden.

stage3_name.description: Display name for Stage3 column. Default: '' (hidden).

stage4_name.description: Display name for Stage4 column. Default: '' (hidden).

current_password.description: Required when 'password' is provided. The user's current password for confirmation.

password.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep current password.

admin_password.description: Required when 'password' is provided or the role is being promoted (user→admin, user→sysadmin, admin→sysadmin). The requesting sysadmin's own current password for confirmation.

IssueWriteRequest.description: Used for both create (POST) and update (PUT). Project is determined by the URL's :pId — any project_id in the body is ignored.

priority.description: Optional. Defaults to empty (Normal) if omitted.

position.description: Optional. Non-negative integer for column ordering.

deadline.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Year must be 2000–2100.

assignee_id.description: Optional. Must reference an active user.

label.description: Optional. Must belong to the same project. Send null to remove the label.

release_id.description: Optional. Must belong to the same project.

TaskCreateRequest.description: Parent issue is determined by the URL's :iId; any issue_id in the body is ignored.

deadline.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Year must be 2000–2100.

position.description: Optional. Non-negative integer for ordering within the issue.

deadline.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Year must be 2000–2100.

position.description: Optional. Non-negative integer for ordering within the issue.

stage1_name.description: Letters and digits only. Empty string hides the column.

stage2_name.description: Letters and digits only. Empty string hides the column.

stage3_name.description: Letters and digits only. Empty string hides the column.

stage4_name.description: Letters and digits only. Empty string hides the column.

release_date.description: Optional. Must not be before start_date. Year must be 2000–2100.

owner_id.description: Optional. ID of the user responsible for this release.

archive_done.description: If true, Done issues assigned to this release are archived when the release is closed.

get.description: Returns 200 OK when the server is running. Used by Kubernetes liveness and readiness probes.

Unauthorized - invalid or expired refresh token, or inactive user

put.description: Allows the authenticated user to change their own password. Requires the current password for confirmation. All sessions are revoked on success.
